def VTask.prevFixed {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x) : ↑(Function.fixedPoints f) :=
  let g : α →o α := f.inf (OrderHom.const α x)
  let p : Function.fixedPoints g := g.gfp
  let p_val : α := p
  have h_g : g p_val = p_val := p.2
  have h_val : p_val = f p_val ⊓ x := by rw [h_g]; simp [OrderHom.inf_apply]
  have h_le_x : p_val ≤ x := by rw h_val; exact inf_le_right _ _
  have h_f_p_le_x : f p_val ≤ x :=
    calc f p_val ≤ f x := f.mono h_le_x
        ... ≤ x := hx
  have h_eq : f p_val = p_val :=
    calc f p_val = f p_val ⊓ x := by rw [inf_eq_left (f p_val) x]; exact h_f_p_le_x
        ... = p_val := h_val
  ⟨p_val, h_eq⟩
